medium.syllabus_scope: First 50% of the ordered syllabus: computer organization and introductory peripherals, ports, keyboard/mouse/monitor/printer basics; later storage and laptop topics excluded.

Questions: Which firmware routine checks or initializes hardware during startup?
What does BIOS traditionally help the computer do during startup?

Which port traditionally connects a PS/2 keyboard or mouse?
A dot-matrix printer is selected for a task that needs duplicate forms. Why can the choice make sense?
Which port is commonly used to transmit digital video and audio to a display?
Which connector commonly carries digital video and audio to a display?
A PC's keyboard and mouse are not detected on PS/2 ports but do work over USB. What is the most targeted next check?
A PC repeatedly loses boot settings after power is disconnected. Which motherboard-related area is relevant to investigate?
A motherboard provides a suitable slot, but the installed graphics card is not detected and needs extra power. What order should troubleshooting follow?

Which older port was designed to transfer multiple data bits in parallel?
A printer uses a daisy-wheel mechanism. Which print property is most characteristic of this type?
Which item is an internal hardware component rather than an external peripheral?
A technician must connect a legacy serial device and a modern USB device. Which principle governs the connection choice?

Which component usually provides the physical connection points for CPU and memory?
Which printer produces output by spraying small ink droplets?
Which removable card format is named in the storage syllabus?

medium.syllabus_scope: Full syllabus practice bank for Mid 2; Mid 1 is the only exam constrained to the first half.

Questions: A hard drive upgrade requires removing an old drive and installing a replacement. Which step protects against avoidable hardware risk?
The PSU fan is obstructed by dust and the PC shuts down under load. Which explanation is most plausible?
A user has a 2.5-inch laptop drive and wants to install an incompatible desktop drive bay device. What should be checked?
A laptop overheats during ordinary use and its fan outlet is blocked by fabric. What should be done first?
A dot-matrix printer is selected for a task that needs duplicate forms. Why can the choice make sense?
A display panel has a measured resolution of 1920×1080. What do these figures represent?
A computer starts directly into one OS, but a lab task requires a dual-OS setup. What should be planned first?
A storage comparison must consider how quickly data can move after a drive is active. Which metric is most relevant?
Two laptop configurations have similar CPUs but different graphics hardware. For graphics-heavy display tasks, which component difference is directly relevant?
A technician must select a printer type for quiet, non-impact printing of ordinary documents. Which choice best fits the named syllabus examples?
The same USB device works through one port but not another. Which diagnostic comparison is sensible?
A new HDD is physically installed but is absent from File Explorer. What is a reasonable next check?
A second hard drive has been connected by data and power cables, but it does not appear in the OS. Which diagnostic order is sensible?
A PC has no power indicator after relocation. What should be checked before disassembling it?
A file server needs more storage capacity but should keep the existing drive. Which syllabus procedure is relevant?
A hard drive is reported as detected in BIOS, but the OS asks to initialize it. It may contain another user's data. What is the safest action?

A component needs a motherboard expansion slot. Which decision is most important before purchase?
An older peripheral offers only a serial interface, while a computer has no built-in serial port. What must be checked before connecting it?

A laptop runs on AC power but its battery never charges. Which check is most relevant before replacing the motherboard?
A PC powers on, but no image appears on the monitor. Which first check best isolates a simple connection issue?
A laptop screen remains dark but an external display works. Which next check best narrows the issue?
A user sees faint output from an inkjet printer. Which check is more relevant than changing the monitor?
A monitor flickers only when the video connector is touched. Which issue is most likely worth checking first?
A disk shows 1 TB capacity but transfer of large files is slow. Which distinction helps diagnose the measurement?
A user must choose between a magnetic HDD and flash drive for portable file transfer. Which distinction is correct?
A printer uses a daisy-wheel mechanism. Which print property is most characteristic of this type?
A technician is asked to replace a PC-XT keyboard with a newer keyboard. What should be checked first?
A RAM upgrade is physically compatible but is not detected after assembly. Which check should come early?
